content: Transparent-textarea-over-highlight-layer technique: two stacked elements share identical font-family/size/line-height/padding/border/white-space/tab-size; textarea text hidden via color:transparent (+ -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent for WebKit/Blink), caret-color kept visible; highlight layer gets pointer-events:none + lower z-index so textarea (on top) receives all input.
